criteria.criterion: Every session (plan, gate-review, work, review, verify) is started through the adapter of its phase's resolved agent; claude is the only adapter registered, and it owns its preflight checks and the phases it supports, any per-run preparation, the command and environment, whether stdout is a record, and the mapping onto the record.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/agent.go: Adapter interface with Supports, Preflight, Prepare, Command and Parse; claudeAdapter is the only one. session.go Run goes through adapterFor. Spec.Agent is set at plan.go, gatereview.go and iterate.go.

criteria.criterion: With every phase on claude, the argv, working directory and environment claude receives are byte-identical to the base binary's for every phase, with and without .vloop/repo-guidelines.md, with and without a plan hash, with and without an effort; CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY, ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE and ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL still reach claude; VLOOP_ACTIVE_TASK, VLOOP_GATE_TASK and a stale VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 are still dropped.
criteria.evidence: agent.go Command moves the removed session.go lines verbatim (WithGuidelines(Args(...)), cmd.Dir, dropEnv, PlanHashEnv). Args and the argv tests in session_test.go are unchanged. run_agent_test.go TestRunClaudeInvocations pins the pass-through and dropped variables and the cwd.

criteria.criterion: Violation: any claude flag, environment variable or record field (beyond schema, agent and cost_source) that differs from the base in a default configuration, even if the tests pass.
criteria.evidence: The diff of record() adds only agent and cost_source and the schema name. ended and wall_ms were already written. No flag or environment change.

criteria.criterion: Violation: agent-specific logic left in the driver — the driver building --plugin-dir, --settings or --output-format, parsing stdout as one JSON document, or reading claude's JSON fields (total_cost_usd, modelUsage, permission_denials) itself — instead of in the Claude adapter.
criteria.evidence: The JSON parsing and the field reading moved from session.go record() into claudeAdapter.Parse. Run only calls ad.Parse.

criteria.criterion: Violation: agent-independent logic moved into the adapter — gates, checks, input or git guards, the lock, budget decisions, masking, stderr capture, timeouts or record numbering.
criteria.evidence: Stderr capture, timeouts, numbering and the lock stay in Run. Masking is passed in as a function. The adapter holds only agent-specific logic.

criteria.criterion: Violation: a per-task agent override, a second adapter, a fence change, or more than one session per phase.
criteria.evidence: There is no per-task override, only claude is registered, and ExtractFence is called as before.

criteria.criterion: Every record is session/v3: every field of session/v2, ended and wall_ms required, plus agent ("claude") and cost_source — "reported" when claude's output has the key total_cost_usd, else "none" with cost_usd 0. schemas/session.v3.json validates them and `vloop schema validate session/v3 <file>` works; schemas/session.v1.json and session.v2.json stay and still validate old records.
criteria.evidence: schemas/session.v3.json requires ended, wall_ms, agent and cost_source. Parse sets CostSource from the key's presence. The schema list tests include session/v3. run_agent_test.go TestRunRecordsWithoutCost validates a none record. The v1 and v2 files are untouched.

criteria.criterion: Stderr capture, masking, timeouts, the lock record, the SESSION RECORD MISSING log line (empty stdout, or stdout that is not claude's JSON) and every exit code are unchanged; `vloop doctor` and the run preflight print exactly what the base prints and fail exactly when it fails.
criteria.evidence: The SESSION RECORD MISSING condition is the same, now reached through Parse. doctorClaude uses the same messages via AgentPreflight. The Run error text is the same, with cmd.Path in place of bin.

criteria.criterion: Readers that consume records during a run (spend for budgets, the lock) read session/v3 as they read v1 and v2.
criteria.evidence: Readers in internal/runs take the fields generically and do not check the schema name. The e2e tests with budgets pass in the go check.

criteria.criterion: docs/domain/execution/session.md defines a session as a fresh process of its phase's agent, Claude Code by default (no longer as a `claude -p` process), and its record section documents session/v3 and says v1 and v2 records mean agent claude; where `agent` and the agent clock (agent_ms) both appear, the page says they differ.
criteria.evidence: The session.md diff reworded the opening and the record section as required, including that v1 and v2 mean agent claude and that duration_ms (the agent clock) and wall_ms differ.

criteria.criterion: The run harness stub in cmd/vloop/run_harness_test.go also logs each argument on its own line, its working directory and its environment, and a committed harness test pins, for a default run, each phase's argv and that the pass-through variables reach claude and the dropped ones do not; committed tests cover session/v3 records with cost_source reported and none. An earlier test changes only where it pins session/v1 or session/v2 in a record, the work notes name that contract item, and the argv tests in internal/driver/session_test.go are unchanged.
criteria.evidence: The stub appends to invocations.log and argv.log is untouched. TestRunClaudeInvocations, TestRunRecordsAreSessionV3 and TestRunRecordsWithoutCost cover this. The edited earlier tests change only session/v1 and v2 to v3, the schema lists and counts, and the field mapping expectation. Only TestSessionFieldMapping changes in session_test.go, and not the argv tests.

notes: The gate-verification of byte-identity against the base binary is the gate's job; I relied on the diff, which moves the argv and environment code verbatim. Check that the work notes name the contract item for the changed earlier tests.
